headline: Fresh Fighting Renews Several Strategic Fronts
war_summary: The latest return finds the strategic line stirring chiefly in Fisherman’s Row, Kings Cage, Tempest Island, Linn Mercy, and Stlican Shelf. Fisherman’s Row has recorded seven base events in the past two hours and 18 in the day, with six Warden, three Colonial, and no neutral positions; enlistments and casualties are both accelerating. Kings Cage has also seen three fresh events, while its casualty rate has sharply quickened, and the board remains seven Colonial bases to one Warden. Tempest Island reports three events in two hours, with all nine bases presently Colonial-held. Linn Mercy has added two recent events and remains a 10–1 Warden majority, though fighting has cooled from its earlier pace. Stlican Shelf, still seven Warden to two Colonial, has posted two new events amid accelerating losses on both sides. Deadlands remains the broadest contested ledger at five Warden and six Colonial bases, with seven ownership events in 24 hours, but no fresh movement in the latest two-hour window. Endless Shore likewise stays active in the day’s record yet has gone quiet at the front most recently.
